user_goal: Correct the published v0.1.7 installer regression, review the correction through the existing PR, publish it as v0.1.8, install it, and attest the exact live result.

authority.verbatim_text: Once hes all green and good, update all docs/surfaces that need it, then merge/close, and make sure we have a release, what was added/fixed and then check in

baseline.protection_evidence: origin/main and public v0.1.7 tag resolve to the protected release commit
baseline.selection_reason: The installer regression was discovered only after publishing and attempting to install v0.1.7.

resources: owned local Plotkeeper installation and listener
semantic_changes: Preserve an explicit zero sentinel when PowerShell invokes connector selection without a user port.
Publish the reviewed correction as v0.1.8 without rewriting the v0.1.7 tag.
Update version, changelog, rollback, release authority, checkpoints, and release-verifier bindings required by the hotfix.
No ledger mutation, unrelated feature change, foreign listener takeover, secret exposure, tag rewrite, force push, or success claim without public/install/live attestation.

invariants: Omitting -Port reaches connector selection with an explicit zero sentinel and never shifts argv.
An explicit valid port retains its existing meaning.
The installer remains fail closed for unknown or foreign listeners.
PR 2 stays open until exact-head CI, CodeRabbit reconciliation, and independent review pass.
Public main, v0.1.8, installed package, connector, owner record, and live service resolve to one exact candidate.
The v0.1.7 release remains immutable and is documented as superseded by v0.1.8.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The exact hotfix and regression are independently validated.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: A test-only or argument-shifting false green.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: PR 2 exact head has green CI and reconciled CodeRabbit feedback.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: GitHub PR 2, CI, CodeRabbit, and maintainer

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Version, docs, rollback, tests, signed receipts, verifier, and guard approve the exact v0.1.8 candidate.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Publishing an unreviewed or mismatched SHA.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Public, installed, and live v0.1.8 behavior matches the approved candidate.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Stale package, failed connector, wrong listener, or unverifiable release.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: GitHub and owned local Plotkeeper service

proof_requirements.claim: A real installer invocation without -Port and the full exact suite prove the regression is corrected.
proof_requirements.required_environment: clean exact candidate and isolated installer surface
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: production-goal review, full tests, PowerShell parse, and installer harness
proof_requirements.expected_observation: VALIDATED PASS with zero open items

proof_requirements.claim: Raw PR review threads and exact-SHA checks prove merge readiness.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: inspect every review thread/comment and exact-head check
proof_requirements.expected_observation: zero unresolved actionable feedback and all required checks success

proof_requirements.claim: Signed phase receipts, server verifier, and trusted guard approve one exact candidate.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: DEPLOY_READY PASS with zero open items

proof_requirements.claim: Public SHA/tag/release/Actions and installed service evidence are exact.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: public metadata, package parity, connector, owner, health, and UI checks

release_requirements.required_receipt: open PR 2 with exact-head CodeRabbit and CI success
signed VALIDATED through DEPLOY_READY bundle accepted by verifier and guard
signed ATTESTED and CLOSED receipts after public/install/live proof

stop_conditions: Unexpected diff, dirty or multiple worktrees, unresolved review or CI, failed installer proof, non-PASS receipt, SHA mismatch, foreign listener risk, secret/runtime-data exposure, or rollback failure.
known_discrepancies: v0.1.7 is public but its no-Port installer invocation failed after upgrading the package; it must remain immutable and be superseded by v0.1.8.

requirement_trace.authority: User-authorized reviewed PR, merge, release, and check-in
